indicator_name: Government Securities Zero-Coupon Yield, 1Y (KASE curve, monthly average)
description: Бескупонная доходность ГЦБ, 1 год (кривая KASE, среднее за месяц)
methodology: Percent per annum, zero-coupon yield of government securities at 1Y, the MONTHLY AVERAGE of KASE's daily Nelson-Siegel curves (r(t) = B0 + B1*f + B2*(f - exp(-t/TAU))), from 2019-11. The latest month (2026-09) averages the 19 curves so far. Before 2024 TAU varied from 0.08 to 5.5, so the long end of individual daily fits can be an artefact; the monthly mean damps it but does not remove it.
